preheader: This weekend in Celebration: a pancake run, holiday markets, Thanksgiving dinner deals, and a few good reads — from Sunni. ☀️
forecast:
Well, good mornin', Celebration! Grab a warm mug and pull up a rocker — the holidays are tiptoein' in and Thanksgiving is just one week away. Dress in layers this weekend, hunni, and keep an eye on your favorite forecast before you head out.

I rounded up your weekend, three good reads, a few sweet local deals, and the neighbors who make this town shine. — Sunni

top_billing.title: Celebration 10K & 5K Pancake Run
top_billing.body: If you do one thing this weekend, sugar, lace up and join the neighbors for the town's favorite breakfast-meets-fitness tradition. Run, jog or stroll — the pancakes are the real prize. Get the details and registration info on the event page.
